description: Apply locks to layers, optionally to every layer inside the target groups (Layer > Lock Layers, Lock All Layers in Group). Locks not listed are turned off; an empty list unlocks

includeGroupContents.description: Also lock every layer inside target groups

locks.description: all, pixels (image pixels), position, transparency (transparent pixels), artboard (prevent auto-nesting). [] unlocks

target.description: Which layers to act on. Give ids (from list_layers or a create tool), names, or active: true

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)
